versions.description_html:
Dataverse for Teams holds two gigabytes of real data, and it sits inside a license most companies already pay for. It arrived in September of 2020 as a free way to build apps right inside Microsoft Teams.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • The Free Database Hiding Inside Microsoft Teams
  • How It Shows Up Inside Microsoft Teams
  • What You Can Actually Build With It
  • It's the Real Dataverse, Just Trimmed Down
  • The Limits You Hit First
  • The Mistake That Catches Almost Everyone
  • What Microsoft Changed in 2026
  • What This Means for You

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
